The tie forces T are based on the characteristic value of the permanent actions gk for the 
horizontal structure. In consequences classes CC3a and CC3b, the characteristic value for 
the permanent actions gk is usually greater than 3.0 kN/m2. If, however, the characteristic 
value of the permanent actions gk is smaller than this value, the tie forces may be defined 
on a project basis.
